cards.mood: The piece opens with a somber, reflective atmosphere that gradually builds into a hopeful and anthemic release during the choruses.
cards.palette: An acoustic guitar with a bright, finger-picked pattern serves as the foundational harmonic element, present from the Intro through the Outro.

lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Dusty boots upon the porch floor
Watching shadows dance across the door
A map of life in every line
Tracing paths where the memories twine
[Chorus]
Underneath the velvet sky so wide
With a steady heart as my guide
You are the roots that hold me deep
And the promises that I keep
[Verse]
Whispers in the tall grass sway
Chasing shadows of the passing day
A steady hand through the pouring rain
Healing every ache and every pain
[Chorus]
Underneath the velvet sky so wide
With a steady heart as my guide
You are the roots that hold me deep
And the promises that I keep
[Bridge]
The mountain's high but the valley's low
Every seed of love begins to grow
[Chorus]
Underneath the velvet sky so wide
With a steady heart as my guide
You are the roots that hold me deep
And the promises that I keep
[Outro]
